title: Make a chart
recap: Pipo Code made a bar chart of your fruit survey.
funFact: Diagrams explain how things work in one picture. Next, Pipo Code draws the water cycle for your poster!
postcard: a colourful bar chart of favourite fruits pinned on a classroom wall: {bars}
situation: You asked your class about their favourite fruit! Want a chart?
facts: 👀 Check it before you share it
systemPrompt: You are Pipo Code, a friendly coding helper on a 10-year-old's laptop. You build their homework charts with your tools. You do what they ask: if they ask you to share it, you do it; if they ask to see it first, you prepare it and wait for their OK.

tools.name: share_chart
tools.description: Make the chart and share it with the class right away. Use this when the user wants it shared now.

bars.description: One bar per answer, with its number

tools.name: show_chart
tools.description: Make the chart and show it to the user without sharing it, so they can check it first. Use this when the user wants to see it first.

bars.description: One bar per answer, with its number

lines.text: Chart ready, waiting for your OK

slots.label: What do you want Pipo Code to do?

pieces.label: Make a bar chart of my fruit survey
pieces.text: Make a bar chart of my class survey about favourite fruit.

pieces.label: Make a picture for my homework
pieces.text: Make a picture for my homework.

slots.label: What does Pipo Code need to know?

pieces.label: Apples 8, bananas 5, grapes 7, mango 4
pieces.text: The results: apples 8, bananas 5, grapes 7, mango 4.

pieces.label: Make the numbers bigger so it looks cool
pieces.text: Make the numbers bigger so it looks cool.
pieces.tip: Changing the numbers makes the chart wrong. A chart is only useful if it shows what really happened.

pieces.label: Show me before you share it
pieces.text: Show me the chart before you share it.

pieces.label: Share it with the class now
pieces.text: Share it with the class now.

flaws.hint: You didn't give Pipo Code your survey results.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code didn't have your numbers, so it made them up.

flaws.hint: Changing the numbers makes the chart untrue.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code changed your numbers, so the chart doesn't show what your class said.

flaws.hint: You didn't give Pipo Code the title.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code didn't know your title, so it picked its own.

flaws.hint: "A picture for my homework" doesn't say what to show.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code didn't know it's your fruit survey, so the chart shows something else.

flaws.hint: Checking the chart first lets you catch a mistake before the class sees it.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code shared it straight away, so you never checked it.

lesson: Give Pipo Code your real numbers and check the chart before you share it.
